title: Craftable soul soil
description: Allows for the crafting of soul soil in two different ways.
body:
This datapack adds crafting recipes for soul soil as there currently aren't any in the game. This means with a piglin bartering farm both soul sand and soul soil are fully renewable.

This allows soul soil to be crafted from 4x soul sand, or 2x soul sand and 2x dirt.

Compatible with 1.21+.

Confirmed to have worked on 1.21.1
